name: @natlang/build
description: A build system in natural language: dependency-graph understanding, closure and order planning, ready-task scheduling and cache validity as pluggable policies, failure diagnosis and reports. The workspace runs commands without a shell, keeps paths inside the root, checks digests and keeps the ledger and cache.

build.description: natlang run applications/build -- GRAPH.json [--goal ID] [--root DIR] [--ready|--choose|--validity crisp|natural-language]
